question: 仓库 pallets/itsdangerous，截止时间 2026-11-16T06:31:18Z，冻结默认分支 672971d66a2ef9f85151e53283113f33d642dabd。Issue #347 提出的类型问题是什么？最终对应哪个 PR、哪个提交，实际改动覆盖哪些模块？请给出处。

claims.text: Issue #347 指出 `Serializer.dumps` 的返回类型不明确，为 `str | bytes`，原因是 `Serializer` 在 `__init__` 中决定自身的返回类型。
Issue #347 还指出，对于 `URLSafeSerializer` 等部分派生类，静态上已知返回类型是 `str` 而不是 `bytes`。
Issue #347 提议把 `Serializer` 泛型化，使派生类可通过继承 `Serializer[str]` 做类型收窄，从而避免 `type:ignore` 或 `assert isinstance(a, str)`，并正确预期 `dumps` 返回 `str`。

evidence.quote: Currently `Serializer.dumps` has an ambiguous return type (`str | bytes`) due to how the Serializer determines its own return type in `__init__`
evidence.author: Daverball

evidence.quote: however for some of the derived classes such as `URLSafeSerializer` we know statically that the return type will be `str` and not `bytes`.
evidence.author: Daverball

evidence.quote: If `Serializer` were generic we could perform this type narrowing when we inherit from `Serializer` by instead inheriting from `Serializer[str]`. That way we don't need to `type:ignore` or `assert isinstance(a, str)` everywhere we use a `URLSafeSerializer` and correctly expect to get a `str` back from `dumps`.
evidence.author: Daverball
